states.revealedText:
SEARCH:
Locals still bitter their leaders left them decades
ago for a 'Utopia in the east. A week after their
train left, the sky to the east started glowing.
They led us to Smolensk, an old Soviet military
facility outside of town, to report our findings.
You may give 1 Player card in your hand
to another player.
states.effect: You may give 1 Player card in your hand to another player. The scratched story says locals still resent leaders who left decades ago for a Utopia in the east, and that a glow in that sky led the searchers to an old Soviet military facility at Smolensk. No door. The card does not say the other player must share your city, does not say this costs an action, and does not say to discard Moscow.

rules: Black Player card for Moscow. Not a port. The frame is black and the compass has no anchor.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is the scratched face.
You may give 1 Player card in your hand to another player. The card names no range, no action cost, and no once-per-turn limit.
notes: Card id 10810. Scratch state card id 10717.
No improvement bullseye is printed. The scratch box covers the center.
The Utopia and Smolensk sentences are flavor. They do not open a door.
This is the only Moscow Player card. It goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
